2792.title: Manual stop does not park queued work
2792.rootCauseOneLine: The stop settles the thread to idle, while the automatic queue gate blocks only stopping threads and ignores the latest manual-stop event.
2792.proposedFix: Block automatic queue delivery after the latest manual stop until a newer client turn request records deliberate resume.
2792.caveats: A distinct monitor signal was not required because the direct automatic queue path reproduced the defect.
